author: ValWood
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**

GO:0031464 Cul4A-RING E3 ubiquitin ligase complex
IBA with PTN000523156 , Q13216

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPBC577.09


Propagation.

-Cul4A is a human gene   which has a paralog Cul4b, so this complex seems human (or  at least metazoa) specific

-The pombe ortholog of Cul4a/cul4b is cul4, which is part of CLRC complex (GO:0043494)

-  Ckn1 is annotated to [Ddb1-Ckn1 complex](https://www.pombase.org/term/GO:0070912)

the parent Cul4-RING E3 ubiquitin ligase complex (GO:0080008)
is more accurate.

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**

* Add the label 'high priority' if needed. Generally high priority issues affect a lot of proteins, and annotations are incorrect (as opposed to just imprecise).
title: PAINT issue: GO:0031464 Cul4A-RING E3 ubiquitin ligase complex IBA with PTN000523156
